title: RetroReport
description: Exit contract of the m_retro (retrospective) mission: campaign post-mortem that turns execution evidence into failure patterns, lessons, and zero or more amendment proposals. Honest 'nothing to amend' is a legal terminal state.

layer_hypothesis.description: Where the fix likely belongs. 'engine' patterns must NOT become amendment proposals (E0 discipline); they are escalated to the human operator.

single_loop_notes.description: Improvements absorbed without rule change (skill usage, prompt discipline) — the single-loop residue, kept for double-loop event accounting.
